breakdown.description: Gamma-centered k-point sampling conflicts with a half-shifted Monkhorst-Pack mesh.
breakdown.reason: The generated specification still includes both a gamma-centered k-point grid requirement AND a half-shifted Monkhorst-Pack mesh (10x10x10 with shift 0.5, 0.5, 0.5). The ground truth removes the contradictory half-shift instruction, specifying only a gamma-centered k-point grid. The agent repeated the original error by keeping the half shift alongside the gamma-centered grid.
